I am a Ph.D. student in the Department of Political Science at Florida State University. I study American politics and political behavior, with a focus on how citizens form and change their opinions. I teach courses on American and comparative politics. My dissertation, “Title of the Dissertation,” asks how a question of interest shapes an outcome of interest.
Before starting my Ph.D. at FSU, I earned a B.A. in political science from Institution in 2022.
